items.exampleEn: A farmer found an old iron cannonball in his field.
items.exampleZh: 一位農夫在他的田裡發現一顆舊鐵砲彈。

items.exampleEn: Antiaircraft guns were placed on the hills around the city during the war.
items.exampleZh: 戰爭期間，城市周圍的山丘上都架了防空砲。

items.exampleEn: In some countries, a prefect is the government's officer in charge of a region.
items.exampleZh: 在某些國家，地方首長是負責管理一個地區的政府官員。
items.glossZh: 地方首長；（學校）學生幹部

items.exampleEn: In the comedy, two silly thieves try to burgle a rich man's house.
items.exampleZh: 在那部喜劇裡，兩個傻乎乎的小偷想闖進一位有錢人家裡行竊。

items.exampleEn: Stealing passwords is a common form of cybercrime.
items.exampleZh: 竊取密碼是一種常見的網路犯罪。

items.exampleEn: Someone called the fire brigade when smoke came out of the kitchen.
items.exampleZh: 廚房冒出煙時，有人打電話叫了消防隊。

items.exampleEn: The organization works to protect human rights around the world.
items.exampleZh: 這個組織致力於保護全世界的人權。

items.exampleEn: The prime minister answered reporters' questions for an hour.
items.exampleZh: 總理回答了記者一個小時的提問。

items.sentenceEn: Volunteers in the village fire brigade train every Saturday.
items.sentenceZh: 村裡消防隊的志工每週六都會受訓。

items.audioEn: Police say most homes in this area are burgled during the day, not late at night.
items.audioZh: 警方說，這一帶的住家大多是在白天遭竊，而不是深夜。
items.questionZh: 根據警方，這一帶的住家大多在什麼時候遭竊？

items.sentenceEn: Cybercrime is growing as more people shop online.
items.sentenceZh: 隨著越來越多人上網購物，網路犯罪也在增加。

items.sentenceEn: The old antiaircraft gun now stands in a quiet corner of the city park.
items.sentenceZh: 那座舊防空砲現在立在市立公園安靜的一角。

items.stemEn: The soldiers loaded a heavy ____ into the big gun and fired it.
items.stemZh: 士兵們把一顆沉重的砲彈裝進大炮裡，然後發射。

items.stemEn: The new police team only handles ____, such as online fraud.
items.stemZh: 這個新的警察小組專門處理網路犯罪，例如網路詐騙。

items.passageEn: Here is our city news for this week. On Monday, the prime minister opened a new center to fight cybercrime, where more than two hundred experts will work. On Wednesday, a cafe on Hanson Street was burgled, but the owner says the thieves only took a box of old menus. Police investigators are still looking for them. On Friday, the fire brigade held an open day, and children could sit in a real fire engine. Finally, a group of high school students won a prize for their short film about human rights.
items.passageZh: 以下是本週的城市新聞。星期一，總理為一個打擊網路犯罪的新中心揭幕，那裡將有兩百多位專家進駐。星期三，Hanson 街上一家咖啡館遭小偷闖入，不過老闆說小偷只拿走一箱舊菜單，警方調查人員仍在追查他們。星期五，消防隊舉辦開放日，孩子們可以坐進真正的消防車。最後，一群高中生以一部關於人權的短片得獎。

options: 抓到闖入咖啡館的小偷
拍了一部關於人權的短片
在網路安全比賽中勝出

items.promptZh: 她被選為學校的學生幹部。
referenceEn: She was chosen as a school prefect.
She was chosen to be a prefect at her school.
rubricZh: 要用 prefect（例如 a school prefect、a prefect at her school）
「被選為」可寫，例如 was chosen as、was elected、was made 等

items.promptZh: 這本書用簡單的文字向孩子解釋人權。
referenceEn: This book explains human rights to children in simple words.
This book uses simple language to explain human rights to children.
rubricZh: human rights 表示「人權」，用複數（例如 explains human rights 等）
「用簡單的文字」可寫，例如 in simple words、uses simple language 等
